description: This file defines a PlaceholderWorker class that extends CoroutineWorker to simulate background tasks in an Android application. It includes basic setup and a simple doWork method that delays briefly before returning success.

classes.name: PlaceholderWorker
classes.description: A worker class that performs minimal simulated background work, intended to be replaced with actual media or message analysis tasks.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the background task, currently simulated with a brief delay, and returns success.
